subject: Starlight site visit — demo window and condensed format
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@starlighthealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onsite demo during Starlight site visit

Hi Irene,

We're finalizing the agenda for our site visit week and would like to lock in a demo with Redwood while the execs and engineering are on site. The visit runs Sept 20–22; the team is tight on time but very interested in a hands-on walkthrough that covers:

- 30–45 minute executive overview (cost/latency SLAs)
- 45–60 minute technical deep-dive (runtime and integration)
- Q&A and next steps (10–15 min)

Who from your side should be there for the technical portion? Our attendees will include our CTO (Tom Nguyen) and Head of Infrastructure (myself). I've attached the site-visit itinerary so you can see the slots we still have open.

Potential windows we can try to carve out: morning of Sept 21 (9:00–11:30 local) or afternoon of Sept 20 (2:30–4:00).

Can you confirm availability and whether an on-site demo team (engineer + solutions) is doable? If needed we can compress the technical section.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Carter
Director, Product & Ops
Starlight Health
emily.carter@starlighthealth.com

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and the itinerary. We're excited to be part of the visit.

Quick answers:
- We can do an on-site demo with an engineer (Jonas) and Soojin from Solutions.
- We can support both a 30–45 minute exec overview + a deeper technical block; if you expect strict time limits we can also condense into a 30-minute exec + recorded deep-dive for your team to review.

Before I lock anything down, would you let us know:
1) The primary audience for the condensed session (exec-only, mixed, or infra-only).
2) Whether you'd prefer a shorter live session + recording, or a single extended block.

Tentative availability from us based on your windows:
- Sept 21: 9:00–9:45 PT (exec + brief Q)
- Sept 20: 14:30–15:30 PT (full walkthrough)

I'm attaching a short outline so you can see how we'd split topics. If you want the condensed option, we can prepare a 30-minute executive script and record the technical demo to share immediately after.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
